runners_data.spotlight: Four course wins, including two over this trip, and he ran his best race for a while when third over C&D four weeks ago; each-way shout.

runners_data.name: Devious Devan
runners_data.note: Will lead but has clear fade-in-finish pattern and poor recent form, making him vulnerable despite getting easy fractions

runners_data.name: Al Baahy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid course record but only 6 days since last run may not be ideal for this longer trip

runners_data.name: Bossy Parker

runners_data.name: Shielas Well

runners_data.comment: On a lowly mark and her last two runs have been okay; respected in new headgear
runners_data.spotlight: She should be well handicapped now and her last two runs have both been respectable; cheekpieces tried last time are now replaced by first-time blinkers; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Angel's Call
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 41-day break with useful apprentice claim but may need the run back from layoff

runners_data.name: Street Dancer
runners_data.note: Hold-up type stepping up in trip with pedigree questions but showed improved form in first handicap attempt
runners_data.comment: Some promise on handicap debut here two weeks ago (7f); new trip could spark extra
runners_data.spotlight: Offered a bit more when a close fifth of eight over 7f here two weeks ago, her first handicap run; speed on bottom line of her pedigree but she is by Cracksman so this step up in trip could help.

runners_data.name: Fumbleinthejungle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with fade-in-finish concerns and poor recent form, likely to weaken after tracking early pace

races.paceDynamic: Devious Devan will lead from the start with Fumbleinthejungle potentially tracking but both have fade-in-finish warnings that make them vulnerable late. With six hold-up horses including course winners Prince Ali and Bossy Parker, this will become a tactical affair with horses queuing up behind a moderate early gallop. The sustainable pace will suit closers who can quicken off the bridle, while the early leaders face being swamped in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Devious Devan sets steady fractions and the pace doesn't quicken until late
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get perfect positioning as the early leaders weaken predictably, allowing multiple closers to challenge simultaneously. Prince Ali and Bossy Parker's course form becomes decisive as they outfinish the fading pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Devious Devan Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Devious Devan gets soft fractions and finds extra resolve in the finish
scenarios.body: Despite his fade-in-finish warning, he gets an easy lead and kicks clear before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenge. The closers leave it too late as the leader's class tells.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fumbleinthejungle Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If Fumbleinthejungle tracks Devious Devan closely and both leaders collapse late
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets first run on the fading leader but also weakens, creating chaos as the field concertinas in the straight. Street Dancer or Angel's Call could profit from the melee with better finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both early leaders fade dramatically and no hold-up horse can organize a clear run
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where positioning matters more than ability, potentially suiting whoever gets the clearest passage. Al Baahy's recent course experience could prove valuable in the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Devious Devan getting easy fractions early could make him hard to peg back despite his finishing limitations
Prince Ali's 29-day break affecting his fitness levels when the pace quickens in the straight
Shielas Well's reaction to first-time blinkers could unlock improvement after recent respectable efforts
Both prominent runners Devious Devan and Fumbleinthejungle fading simultaneously and creating a pace collapse
Street Dancer's stamina holding out at this longer trip given her sprint pedigree and previous 7f efforts

runners_data.name: Wosta
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity from top connections making debut, style unclear but breeding suggests stamina will suit this trip

runners_data.name: Bintaziza

runners_data.name: Symphony's Song

runners_data.comment: Absent since recording a meagre RPR on AW 14 months ago for George Boughey
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since fourth of five, recording a meagre RPR, in 7f AW maiden at Newcastle 14 months ago for George Boughey; best watched unless the market speaks positively.

runners_data.name: Midnight Media
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades late, concerning pattern with weak finishes in recent starts despite trainer change

runners_data.name: Guesstimate
runners_data.note: Back-marker who stays well, solid recent second shows she's competitive at this level under Tom Marquand

runners_data.name: Golden Mabel
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type who has struggled in two starts, apprentice jockey claim helpful but needs major step forward

races.paceDynamic: Romance Spirit and Symphony's Song will likely set a steady pace from the front, with no other confirmed pace pressers in this small field. The lack of early speed creates a sustainable tempo that will suit those who can sustain their effort. With most runners preferring to come from behind (Bintaziza, Midnight Media, Guesstimate), the pace-setters won't face early pressure but will need to find acceleration when the closers mount their challenges in the straight. This moderate pace scenario clearly favours hold-up horses who can deliver strong finishing kicks over those dependent on dictating terms.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominant Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains pedestrian as expected with Romance Spirit and Symphony's Song uncontested.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks, with Bintaziza and Guesstimate perfectly positioned to strike. The lack of early pace allows stamina to tell over the extended distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Romance Spirit and Symphony's Song go too slow early then fail to quicken when challenged.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells, allowing the better-rated horses to exploit their superiority. Wosta's unknown ability and Bintaziza's proven form become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Romance Spirit maintains steady fractions then finds extra gear when pressed.
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on her rivals and stays ahead of the closing pack. Symphony's Song could also benefit from prominent positioning if she shows more than recent form suggests.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire and one of the longer shots finds unexpected improvement.
scenarios.body: Golden Mabel or Symphony's Song could exploit a false pace or benefit from the extended trip. Their light weights and potential for progress could overcome class disadvantages.

watchPoints.text: Romance Spirit could get an easy lead if Symphony's Song doesn't show pace, making her very dangerous
Wosta's market support will reveal Gosden's expectations for this unraced filly from powerful stable
Midnight Media's tendency to fade badly in the final furlong makes her unreliable despite decent positions
Bintaziza's 100% record on similar going gives her a significant edge if the pace setup suits
Symphony's Song's 425-day absence makes her fitness questionable despite the extended trip suiting

runners_data.name: Zipwire
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose headgear application sparked two wins but faces 40 days off and must overcome uncontested leader
runners_data.comment: Two wins, including C&D, and a second since cheekpieces went on; should go well again
runners_data.spotlight: He had looked exposed prior to headgear going on in December but it sparked improvement, winning over 8.6f in December and following up over C&D in March; came up short in his hat-trick bid at Chelmsford (1m2f) 16 days ago but still ran well; respected.

runners_data.name: Lexington Express
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with two recent AW wins leading throughout, but 3lb penalty and quick 12-day turnaround tests stamina
runners_data.comment: On the up this spring, winning two of her last three; easy lead a possibility; contender
runners_data.spotlight: 0-9 for Alice Haynes but she has won two of her five starts for Marco Botti, both front-running wins on AW; 3lb rise for narrow win 12 days ago asks a stiffer question but she should enjoy the run of the race.

runners_data.name: Mimi's Magic
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but limited winning form and faces tactical nightmare against uncontested leader from poor draw position
runners_data.comment: Placed twice from four starts; improvement needed now handicapping but it's not impossible
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two of her four starts, the latest when third to Bintaziza (runs in the 7.00) at Newcastle two weeks ago (1m); needs more now handicapping but it is not out of the question.

runners_data.name: Tinsel
runners_data.note: Fresh after 136-day break as course winner but hold-up style creates major tactical disadvantage in this pace scenario
runners_data.comment: The manner of his 9.5f AW win suggests this return to 1m is a negative
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since opening his account in Class 6 handicap at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) just before Christmas; the only last-time scorer in this field but doesn't give the impression he's crying out for return to 1m.

races.paceDynamic: Lexington Express will dictate from the front with no genuine pace pressure, having won his last two starts leading throughout on the all-weather. Zipwire, Mimi's Magic and Tinsel all prefer to be held up, creating a tactical scenario where the leader faces minimal early harassment. The lack of prominent racers means Lexington Express can control splits and kick when ready. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and any horse that can track close early, while hold-up horses face the difficult task of making up ground against an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Lexington Express gets an easy lead and controlled fractions
scenarios.body: Marco Ghiani can dictate every fraction without pressure, then quicken when the hold-up horses are still organizing their challenges. The lack of pace pressure creates the perfect scenario for a confirmed front-runner with recent winning form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing or Lexington Express stops
scenarios.body: Zipwire's headgear improvement and class edge could tell in a sprint finish, especially with the 3lb weight advantage over the leader. Tinsel also brings fresh legs after 136 days off and was a course winner last time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Lexington Express goes too slow early and multiple horses quicken together
scenarios.body: All four runners arrive in a bunch turning for home, creating a cavalry charge where Mimi's Magic's recent run and Tom Marquand's tactical awareness on Tinsel could prove decisive. The 3lb weight spread keeps them tightly bunched.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Stops Suddenly
scenarios.trigger: If Lexington Express hits the front too early or the 3lb penalty bites
scenarios.body: The front-runner's recent quick return and step up in class catches up with him in the final furlong, allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past. Zipwire's proven course form becomes crucial in a late rally.

watchPoints.text: If Lexington Express gets first quarter-mile uncontested, the hold-up horses face nearly impossible task
Zipwire's 40-day absence could blunt finishing kick despite headgear improvement and weight advantage
Tom Marquand may force earlier pace on Tinsel to prevent Lexington Express from controlling completely
Marco Ghiani's front-running tactics on Lexington Express will dictate whether others get any chance
Mimi's Magic needs pace pressure early or will struggle to make up ground from her hold-up position

runners_data.name: Amakhala
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who fades late, 17 days since last run and faces traffic nightmare from back of field

races.paceDynamic: Amber Hamur is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the bell, likely getting an uncontested lead in the early stages. Amazing Anita, Apex Star and Poetic Grace can track prominently but none are aggressive pace-pressers, allowing Amber Hamur to control fractions. The majority field comprises hold-up horses including Power Of Chora, Pink Diamond Girl, Evolve, Castlekeely, Bear Steps, Musical Soldier, Amakhala and East India Breeze, creating a bunched finish scenario. This tactical setup strongly favours the pace-setter and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Amber Hamur gets easy fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The George Boughey runner controls the tempo completely and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges. Jack Callan can dictate when to inject pace and the hold-up brigade struggle to make up the ground in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Amazing Anita or Apex Star can sit close enough to Amber Hamur without being trapped
scenarios.body: The pace-setter weakens in the final furlong after doing too much alone, allowing a well-positioned prominent runner to strike. The hold-up horses still face too much traffic to be effective.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and Amber Hamur comes back to the field quickly
scenarios.body: The front-runners collapse and a cleaner passage opens up for one of the many hold-up horses to deliver a telling late challenge. Musical Soldier with Hollie Doyle or Power Of Chora could benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Amber Hamur goes off too fast early and the prominent horses also overrace
scenarios.body: The entire pace-setting group weakens dramatically in the final quarter-mile, creating chaos and allowing a complete outsider from the back to sweep through. This would require serious tactical errors up front.

watchPoints.text: Amber Hamur's early fractions are crucial - if Jack Callan goes too fast early the entire race complexion changes
Amazing Anita's stall position when declared will determine if she can track the leader or gets caught wide
Traffic problems in straight will be severe with 8+ hold-up horses converging - watch for clear runs
Power Of Chora and Musical Soldier carry bottom weights but need everything to fall right from hold-up positions
Apex Star's finishing kick last time suggests he could capitalize if positioned close enough to the pace

races.paceDynamic: Lismacbryan Hill will likely take this field along from the front, with Colors Of Freedom, Trust Sergei and Kento happy to sit prominently behind. The pace should be genuine but not frantic over this minimum trip, with the front runner getting an easy enough lead early. The hold-up horses Tomarlo, Vault Of Heaven, Isla Bella and Black Cab will need to rely on the pace collapsing or find gaps late. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can track the leader and pounce late without getting too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine but not excessive allowing prominent runners to strike
scenarios.body: Lismacbryan Hill sets up the race perfectly for those tracking just behind to come through in the final furlong. Colors Of Freedom, Trust Sergei and especially in-form Kento are ideally positioned to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Lismacbryan Hill gets soft fractions early and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The 139-day absence could actually help freshness and with Ray Dawson taking over, the front runner proves hard to peg back. Those tracking prominently like Kento still pose the main threat.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Back
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong enough to set up the hold-up horses
scenarios.body: The prominent pack goes too hard allowing Isla Bella or Black Cab to sweep through late with their finishing kicks. Recent third-place finisher Isla Bella particularly benefits from a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lismacbryan Hill goes too slow and it becomes a sprint from the turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where natural pace horses can dominate from wherever they are positioned. This could allow any horse with tactical speed to win regardless of early position.

watchPoints.text: Lismacbryan Hill breaking smartly is crucial as any hesitation will hand initiative to prominent pack
Trust Sergei market moves given his disappointment as favourite last time despite being well-handicapped
Kento and Rossa Ryan combination has strong strike rate and horse is clearly thriving in current conditions
Black Cab gate speed is vital as slow start killed chances last time and 5f gives no recovery time
Isla Bella benefiting from quick turnaround after decent effort eight days ago over course and distance

runners_data.name: Court Drive

runners_data.name: Magna
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with strong recent sprint form who should get uncontested lead with Ryan's 2-2 strike rate aboard

races.paceDynamic: Magna is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and should get an easy lead from the gates. With Moostar the only other prominent racer, Magna will face minimal early pressure and can dictate terms through moderate fractions. The four hold-up horses (So Sassy, Daytona Lady, Court Drive, Skellig Isle) will be bunched behind waiting to strike. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic that will inevitably develop when multiple hold-up horses try to weave through in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Magna Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Magna breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from Moostar
scenarios.body: She can string out the field with steady fractions and prove too tough to peg back when the hold-up brigade launches their challenge. Her recent C&D success and strong sprint form make her ideally suited to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four hold-up horses get shuffled back early and struggle for racing room
scenarios.body: The sustained pace allows closers with clear runs to sweep past tired leaders in a messy finish. Court Drive and So Sassy have the class to capitalize if they avoid trouble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moostar Pressures Early
scenarios.trigger: If Moostar takes the fight to Magna from the start creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: Both front runners could weaken late opening the door for the best closer to strike. Daytona Lady's recent C&D win gives her the edge in a speed-favoured scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both Magna and Moostar go too conservatively creating crawling fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the three-furlong pole where natural speed trumps position. Fresh horses with tactical pace like Skellig Isle can exploit the sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Magna breaks slowly or Moostar immediately challenges her - destroys the front runner's tactical advantage completely
So Sassy gets trapped behind leaders turning for home - her sweeping style needs clear water to be effective
Court Drive shows ring-rust early after 64-day absence - could compromise her finishing kick when race develops
Daytona Lady settles too far back given small field size - may leave herself too much to do despite C&D form
Multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously in straight - creates interference and favours those with clear runs
